summary: Ero Copper Corp. filed a Form 6-K containing its Management's Discussion and Analysis, Condensed Consolidated Interim Financial Statements, and a press release for the first quarter ended March 31, 2026. This is a routine quarterly financial report by a foreign private issuer under the 1934 Act, with no mention of any M&A, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or forced management change. The filing exclusively covers operational and financial performance. Accordingly, it does not qualify as a special situation. The company is the issuer of the report, but no transactional event is disclosed.
